about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover SDV6 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover SDV6 has been part of the Range Rover line-up since the L322 generation, spanning two generations under one engine badge. Both the L322 (2001–2012) and L405 (2012–2021) use the 4.4-litre TDV8/SDV8 diesel V8 — a sibling engine family to the TDV6/SDV6, sharing the same timing chain and injector wear patterns. The engine was discontinued with the arrival of the L460 generation, which replaced it with Ingenium diesel and BMW-sourced V8 units. The Range Rover SDV6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Range Rover SDV6 Engine Codes TDV8/SDV8 (L322, L405) A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover SDV6 from 2001 to 2021 across two generations. Known for timing chain and injector wear over time — see the callout above. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo and gaskets as standard on every TDV8/SDV8 rebuild. Check Your TDV8/SDV8 Range Rover SDV6 → [link to quote form] Land Rover Range Rover SDV6 Engine Compatibility Because the Range Rover SDV6 runs the same TDV8/SDV8 engine family across both generations, compatibility comes down to generation-specific ancillaries and ECU configurations rather than a different engine code. The Range Rover SDV6 uses the 4.4-litre TDV8/SDV8 diesel V8, fitted across the L322 (2001–2012) and L405 (2012–2021) generations. How much does a Land Rover Range Rover SDV6 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £4,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover SDV6? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact TDV8/SDV8 specification before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild TDV8/SDV8 Range Rover SDV6 engines? Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo and gaskets as standard on every TDV8/SDV8 rebuild. Do you supply used Range Rover SDV6 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Range Rover SDV6 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Range Rover SDV6 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover SDV6 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover SDV6 from 2023 to present. The TDV8/SDV8 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV8/SDV8 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV8/SDV8 rebuild.
